name: Truc Lam Ban Gioc Pagoda
nameVi: Chùa Phật Tích Trúc Lâm Bản Giốc
summary: Climb the short, steep walk to Truc Lam Ban Gioc when you want the valley behind the roof, not only the hall. The pagoda is on Phia Nhan, in the same Dam Thuy valley as the falls. Skip it if you have already used the afternoon and the light is gone.
getThere: Same valley as Ban Gioc. Minutes from the falls are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The pagoda roof at Truc Lam Ban Gioc, with the karst valley behind it

notice.title: The viewpoint is the visit
notice.body: A frame of the hall alone loses the valley. In the low-water months the falls themselves are still a 10:30 to 15:30 visit. Do not save the pagoda for after that window and expect the cascade at its best.

body: The geopark calls this the first Truc Lam pagoda of its line built on this northern border. You climb Phia Nhan and look down on the Quay Son and the fields. Vietnam Tourism calls the walk short and steep. Under an hour once you are there is the shape of it. The exact count is check on arrival.

The photograph here is the roof and the karst valley. It does not put the cascade in the same frame. If the falls are what you came to see from this height, wait for a clear view and do not stop at the hall door.
Do it on the falls day, not as a trip of its own from Hanoi. A fee is check on arrival. No tariff was on the geopark article or on Vietnam Tourism.

figures.caption: The stair of halls on the climb at Truc Lam Ban Gioc
figures.alt: People climbing stone stairs between tiled halls at Truc Lam Ban Gioc pagoda

gettingThere: The pagoda is on Phia Nhan, in Dam Thuy, in the same valley as Ban Gioc. The eastern road from the city is the falls road: more than 80 km, then the valley. Minutes from the gate of the falls up to the pagoda are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ban Gioc
legs.body: Same valley. Vietnam Tourism calls the walk short and steep. No published minute count from the falls to the first hall was on the pages read.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: East with the falls day, more than 80 km. Drive minutes are check on arrival.
